claim: Allowing job migration transforms the NP-complete MinTPT scheduling problem into a polynomially solvable problem, enabling attainment of the theoretical lower bound.
falsifier: Implement a scheduler that allows a bounded number of job migrations for MinTPT instances and verify that the resulting total power-on time matches the theoretical lower bound (sum of minimum machines per slot).

conditions: the scheduling problem is MinTPT (minimizing total power-on time) without job migration is NP-complete
a limited number of job migrations is permitted
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the MinTPT problem as defined in the source; transferability to other scheduling problems is unestablished.

title: Allowing job migration for transformation of the scheduling
